claims.text: Test what the history and exam suggest; without a clue, labs rarely find a cause.
claims.quote: Testing is directed at causes suspected based on clinical findings. If no cause is evident or suspected based on clinical findings, laboratory testing is unlikely to reveal a cause.

claims.text: Common baseline: CBC, ferritin, ESR, TSH, and chemistries (electrolytes, glucose, calcium, renal and liver tests).
claims.quote: Still, many clinicians recommend testing with the following: Complete blood count (CBC) Ferritin Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) Chemistries, including electrolytes, glucose, calcium, and renal and liver tests

claims.text: CK if there is muscle pain or weakness; chest x-ray if there is cough or dyspnea.
claims.quote: Creatine kinase (CK) is recommended if muscle pain or weakness is present. HIV testing and testing for tuberculosis with purified protein derivative (PPD) placement or interferon-gamma release assays are recommended if the patient has risk factors. Chest radiograph is recommended if cough or dyspnea is present.

claims.text: HIV and TB testing if there are risk factors.
claims.quote: HIV testing and testing for tuberculosis with purified protein derivative (PPD) placement or interferon-gamma release assays are recommended if the patient has risk factors.
